news.headline: Podziemski closed with 15 points (5-12 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 5-6 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one steal in 32 minutes during Thursday's 126-98 loss to the Grizzlies.

news.headline: Podziemski supplied 18 points (5-14 FG, 4-10 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds and two assists in 38 minutes during Sunday's 88-87 win over the Celtics.
news.story: Podziemski led Golden State in scoring and played a substantial role in snapping the team's five-game losing streak in a low-scoring contest where neither team reached 90 points. However, six turnovers and limited playmaking diminished an otherwise useful fantasy line. The heavy workload is encouraging, but his production remains stronger when he supplements perimeter scoring with his playmaking numbers. He should…

news.headline: Podziemski closed with 15 points (5-12 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 5-6 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one steal in 32 minutes during Thursday's 126-98 loss to the Grizzlies.
news.story: Podziemski has missed all 10 three-point attempts over his last two games, undermining his scoring efficiency despite consistent shot volume. He's maintained roughly 30 minutes per game recently, but Golden State's struggling offense without Stephen Curry (abdomen) has limited his playmaking opportunities. His fantasy ceiling depends on rediscovering his perimeter touch.

news.headline: Podziemski accumulated 10 points (5-13 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 0-2 FT), three rebounds and four assists over 29 minutes during Wednesday's 116-94 loss to the Mavericks.
news.story: Podziemski has averaged 16.0 points, 4.0 rebounds, 3.0 assists and 2.8 triples over his last five games. However, he's shot just 38.5 percent from the field during that stretch. His consistent offensive involvement provides fantasy appeal, though poor shooting and fluctuating minutes limit his reliability.
